card.name: Digits inside phone and ISBN numbers
card.fires_on: A single digit in the middle of a phone number or ISBN, usually 6, 7 or 8 after a dash and a few digits, as in contact lines for reporting side effects or registries.

modes.label: Phone numbers
modes.description: A middle digit in a toll-free or registry phone number.
modes.example: Healthcare providers are encouraged to register patients by calling the National Pregnancy Registry for Psychiatric Medications at 1-866-9<<6>>1-2388 or visiting

modes.label: ISBN numbers
modes.description: A middle digit in a book ISBN citation.
modes.example: Cambridge, Massachusetts: Harvard University Press. ISBN 0-674-5<<8>>733-2. Retrieved

card.plain: It fires on a digit in the middle of a phone number or book ISBN number.
